            NODE_ENV=production
            APP_VERSION=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.image-tag }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Push to ECR
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:

          cache-from: type=gha

      - name: Integration Tests
        run: |
          npm run test:integration -- --baseUrl=${{ vars.STAGING_URL }} --reporter=junit

  # ── STAGING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  staging:
    name: Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build, test]
    environment: staging
    steps:

      # [seq:9] step.deploy (helm) → azure/setup-helm + helm upgrade (pattern: deploy-to-environment)
      - name: Deploy to Staging
        run: |
          helm upgrade --install crm-staging charts/crm-app \
            --kube-context staging-eks-cluster \
            --namespace staging \
            --set image.tag=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.image-tag }} \
            --set image.repository=${{ env.ECR_REPO }} \
            --set replicaCount=2 \
            --wait

      # [seq:10] step.freestyle (newman) — fallback: no newman action, raw run step used
      - name: Smoke Tests
        run: |
          npx newman run collections/smoke-tests.json \
            --env-var BASE_URL=${{ vars.STAGING_URL }} \
            --env-var API_KEY=${{ secrets.STAGING_API_KEY }} \
            --reporters cli,junit \
            --reporter-junit-export results/smoke.xml

    name: Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: staging
    environment: production

  notify:
